title: Complete ability authoring: later means-based discovery qualifies the universal kernel and habit limits

reviews.classification: Full ability owner with requested direction, historical implementation claims and conflicting proposal rounds
reviews.disposition: Retain all variants/habit/kernel proposals; fold actual source/means/actor distinctions, user-chosen UI depth and current AD46/51/52. No universal kernel, slots, forced tradeoffs or progression locks adopted.
reviews.evidence: Full454line body read in three bounded chunks. Earlier source snapshots, missing-worktree claim, official links and current runtime not newly verified.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B339: full authoring owner and later direction
folds.body:
All454 original lines were reviewed, from family/source distinctions through the complete execution and review contract, conceptual references, AB1–AB5, all habit/depth/complexity rounds, ASR1–ASR15, SP1–SP6, every sense/world/system-cheat row, OD25 and the later cross-pursuit pointers. Preserve local code scopes: ASR is this proposed simple-rule family, not registered site SR; AB labels here differ from other owners' local abstraction tables. The recorded user allowance for genuinely stronger variants and chosen simple/complex involvement remains direction; exact habit capacity, kernel, fields, progression and ordering remain proposals.

The opening causal contract already supplies the right distinction: family/result, actual source instance, learned competence, body/control, current support, target and retained output. A family tag never proves interchangeable function. A transferred faculty, temporary imitation, taught method, recording and personal mastery need their actual carriers and consequences. The same acquired power can have modes; a later source revision or donor improvement cannot silently rewrite an already acquired independent record. A genuinely superior faculty can outperform weaker routes with no compulsory niche, tax or counter. The phrase about outperforming needing tested new functions should not exclude a legitimate source-defined faculty that supplies them directly.

Keep author truth, available evidence, actual observer claims and displayed preview separate. A known-input preview does not spend the operation's random draw; an actual in-world assay, prediction or sensing action may spend resources and produce new knowledge through its own command. A valid detector may read exact hidden facts when its actual source supports that route, without granting every observer the same knowledge. Seeing a tag once is not a universal habit-editor prerequisite: a character can follow a taught rule or device's supported sensor even when it cannot personally name the hidden mechanism. Conversely a player-visible expression cannot simply inspect author-private state without such a means. Sealing follows the actual discovery/publication rule.

Later user depth direction qualifies the earlier “no variables/loops/nesting” two-slot sketch. D0–D4 can keep a simple view and retain advanced instructions; D3/D4 are not earned by repeatedly editing D2 (X1). Capacity can be diegetic where a mechanism needs it, but a fixed one/two-slot start, mandatory manual repetition, fade-timer bad habits or in-world unlock for ordinary interface convenience is not adopted by this note. A stable successful standing rule is useful even when it is never edited; low interaction does not by itself prove decoration or justify deleting it. D0 temperament and D0 unchanged-base behavior are different proposals and cannot both be inferred from the label alone.

A shared condition language, explanation projection or execution seam may be useful; it does not follow that every ability, social motive, material and law is a tag bundle on one universal grammar. Current AD46/AD51 preserve real differences and allow the first useful justified seam, with a second different world validating it. ASR2's three-case threshold, SP4's tag-store-first order and the mandatory two-variant proof are unselected recommendations. A lower-layer256-effect safety bound is not a world-law cap on a valid chain, and a rule's single-moment recursion policy cannot silently remove supported recurrence or delayed effects. Person/street/region scale may need different aggregation and contact semantics rather than sharing an unqualified wet tag.

Do not import the sense examples as universal source laws. A life sensor might include undead, a lie detector might test objective falsity or sincere belief, and an intent reader need not answer truth. Smell rot, soul fading and radiation are not necessarily one underlying state merely because SN4 suggests a shared tag. Medium, target, reach, timing, fidelity, communication and actual source distinguish the variant. A borrowed dog's perception includes a real animal's agency and reporting limits, not only a fed sensor. Greater sensing scope need not automatically cause overload or a detectable ping. A stale report can be retained without assuming all facts expire after the same timestamp.

World progress, attention, danger and memory are separate consequences. A successful deed need not raise threats, monsters need not learn without a capable actual agent, a place need not decay on a maintenance timer, and every world need not acquire two or three bars. World change and closed-app time require the actual clock/policy; the sentence that worlds always move without the player is not a general clock decision. Likewise simple UI must remain useful, but a more careful supported strategy can produce substantially better real results without an artificial small-edge ceiling. Current AD52 removes a blanket click bonus, preserves actual agency/cost/time and allows effective means to remove chores.

The system-cheat ease guard is a palette, not an anti-power rule. A system may arrive with full content, be independent of local monster XP, outperform native systems, grant durable transformations or lack a patron/price where its actual source says so. No law reserves one native-only advantage for each world. Local terminology aids comprehension without rewriting source mechanisms. Scope can spread only through actual transmission/teaching/support; losing a system removes what genuinely depends on it rather than all granted numbers by category. A personality-bearing source can make real decisions, so CS7's text-style-only example is not an exhaustive account of its agency.

Offline habits can produce learning through actual qualifying action, observation, study or communication; the early no-new-learning rule is not universal. A manual override governs the relevant command boundary and must settle committed costs/partial progress rather than erase them. Multiple actors can validly cooperate on one target, so H5's claimed-target skip needs actual role/capacity semantics, not a global prohibition on two healers. The later OD25 section already qualifies procedural composition as a selected finite interaction family, with exact effects and evidence rather than invented grants or canon.

All old source-file/LOC counts, no-cheat-runtime/tag-store/simultaneous-resolver claims and the lost worktree report retain their original revision. This read neither recovered a runtime nor established present absence, and the historical official anime/creator-description checks do not newly qualify manga extremes or game behavior. Generic human review is optional under AD42; selected implementation still needs its actual source/consumer and relevant behavior/persistence evidence. No ability, kernel, habit list, save migration, source reading, new worker or runtime gate was implemented by this review.
